execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."administration" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."categoryEntreprise" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "storageKey" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."entreprise" (
  "addresse" text NOT NULL,
  "agentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "categoryId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isPartenaire" bool NOT NULL,
  "kbisId" text NOT NULL,
  "motifId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "postalCode" text NOT NULL,
  "siret" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "verified" bool NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."historiqueTransactionEntreprise" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entrepriseId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."historiqueTransactionSalarie" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "salarieId" text NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."motifValidationEntreprise" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "motif" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transaction" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "envoyeurId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "montant" int4 NOT NULL,
  "receveurId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userRole" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiredAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "roleId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "surname" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
